# Plugin.Maui.BiometricPlus

One-shot Face ID / fingerprint / device PIN prompt for .NET MAUI.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.Biometric
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BiometricPlus
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-biometric/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 23+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.1. Host apps must declare Android `USE_BIOMETRIC` and iOS `NSFaceIDUsageDescription`.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BiometricPlus

Registration: `UseBiometric` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I show Face ID / fingerprint once in MAUI?
- Device PIN fallback for a one-shot prompt
- await Biometric.Current.AuthenticateAsync()

## Do not use when

- AppLock timer + cover (use Plugin.Maui.AppLock)
- Token lock (use Plugin.Maui.SecureSession)
- Hardware probe only (use Plugin.Maui.DeviceInfoPlus)
